principles: END GOAL (docs/README.md): every doc is an expectation the substrate holds about itself, ingested into concept-db and read by the drafter; nine architectural purposes: ontology, execution/walk, learning from traces, self-development, topology/federation, identity/trust, interface, operations, gap management
Four primitives only (impulse, pointer, resolver, vessel); a shape is a routing-and-reasoning key never a schema; a fifth primitive or a rename is drift (docs/README.md §1; shapes/README.md)
Judge reached, not exit status; credit follows the reach verdict and ungraded outcomes are skipped, never credited or blamed (docs/README.md §2-3; learning/FAILURE_MODES.md)
A document no reader consumes is an archive; docs/architecture headings are a frozen interface; keep sections >200 chars; load-bearing claim early (self-development/DOC_INGESTION.md)
A schema defines what may be recorded, it does not cause recording: census before reasoning; a zero is not a zero until a positive control shares the query (learning/FAILURE_MODES.md)
A warning collected into a structure the caller discards is observed by nobody: find its reader (learning/FAILURE_MODES.md)

Behavioural values are read at use time with no env fallback; configuration is the one region with no learning loop; config-surface size measures unfinished shaping (thompson_posterior.md; operations/CONFIGURATION_SURFACE.md §3)
A probe that cannot run must say so, never produce a number; a check that reads one artifact and exercises another measures the gap between them (CONFIGURATION_SURFACE.md §6)
A check nothing invokes cannot be trusted when it passes (CONFIGURATION_SURFACE.md §7)

Qualification = deterministic-verdict correctness (LLM-judged green does not count), delivery, containment, and repair with executed post-land verification; an unverified landing is an activation not a repair; any operator hand disqualifies the cycle (QUALIFICATION.md)
Reuse without adaptation is memorization; adaptation without reuse means nothing was learned (QUALIFICATION.md)

Selftest = dispatched intervention with known ground truth, asserted at the consuming layer, controls mandatory, isolation by attribution not environment, falsifier anchors immutable once filed (validation/LEARNING_LOOP_SELFTEST.md)
The pool grades what it selects; a timer fires forever regardless of outcome, so timer-plane work cannot be learned away (SUBSTRATE.md dev-vessel specifics)

Memory about the system belongs to the system; operator files are a cache; memoryNote teaches the operator, concept-db teaches the drafter; name the runtime reader before writing a lesson (MEMORY_AS_SUBSTRATE.md)
Single table owner; read across, write through the owner's resolver; the owner migrates and owns PERMISSIONS; tenant isolation lives in the table; never hand-edit a live DB (SCHEMA_OWNERSHIP.md)
The producer declares how its duplicates are treated; the identity secret defines the namespace boundary (operations/FEDERATION_GENRES.md)
Advertise and dispatch together under a checker; a shape never resolved by a walk is a declaration not a capability; prefer adding a shape over renaming (shapes/README.md)
origin/dev is the only code channel; pushing is deployment; host docker-cp is not a delivery path; one unit property lives in one file (SUBSTRATE.md; CONFIGURATION_SURFACE.md §1)
Specs should carry explicit 'what ships vs what is design' blocks naming the missing consumer (specs/*.md, thompson_posterior.md)
The substrate cannot self-declare S3; push-away with cited evidence is the signal (SUBSTRATE.md)
